title: Sparse designs via quantization of the uniform measure on high-dimensional hypercubes
abstract: arXiv:2611.24507v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While the notions of sphere packing and sphere covering underlie the most widely used criteria for space-filling design in computer experiments, namely, the maximin and minimax approaches, they suffer from major drawbacks in high dimensions. First, when the dimension $d$ is very large, deploying a space-filling design requires an extremely large number of design points, making the very notion of a space-filling design questionable. Second, these two design characteristics are highly sensitive to boundaries, particularly when the design domain is a hypercube (the case considered in this paper), and especially to its vertices. This sensitivity is particularly acute when the design size is less than $2^d$. Instead of considering the maximin or minimax criterion, we consider here the quantization error of the uniform measure on the hypercube. translated_title: 通过高维超立方体上均匀测度的量化构造稀疏设计
translated_abstract: 虽然球填充和球覆盖的概念构成了计算机实验中空间填充设计最广泛使用的准则——即maximin和minimax方法——的基础，但它们在高维情况下存在重大缺陷。首先，当维度 $d$ 非常大时，部署空间填充设计需要极其大量的设计点，这使得空间填充设计这一概念本身变得值得质疑。其次，这两种设计特征对边界高度敏感，尤其是当设计域为超立方体时（即本文考虑的情形），对其顶点尤为敏感。当设计规模小于 $2^d$ 时，这种敏感性表现得特别突出。本文不再采用maximin或minimax准则，而是考虑超立方体上均匀测度的量化误差。该误差具有三个关键优势：它考虑了从一个随机点出发的距离分布的整体情况（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出用超立方体上均匀测度的量化误差替代传统的maximin/minimax准则来构造高维稀疏空间填充设计，从而克服了高维下所需设计点数过多以及对边界（尤其是超立方体顶点）过度敏感的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using the quantization error of the uniform measure on high-dimensional hypercubes as an alternative to the maximin/minimax criteria for sparse space-filling designs, overcoming the drawbacks of excessive design point requirements and high sensitivity to boundaries (especially hypercube vertices) in high dimensions.
